description: AI Topographic 2D Building Outlines - CaptureWA (LGATE-338) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Landgate. This dataset is an AI extracted topographic feature polygon indicating the outline of a building. The outline does include all structures attached to the dwelling itself and does not delineate from roof, carport, or patio etc. This dataset was provisioned through CaptureWA with the approval of WALIS (Western Australian Land Information System). Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Landgate. Its tags are AI, Artificial Intelligence, BFD, BuildingPolygon, Local Government. It offers 10 resource(s) in api arcgis server feature service, api arcgis server map service, fgdb, geojson, geopackage. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom (Government Use). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
